description: City Union Bank's Q2 FY27 results in the 28 October 2026 evening brief: one board-outcome filing and eight publisher reports of the same results, printed as nine separate updates because one differing figure voided the whole grouping reply. Headlines and times are the edition's own; the filing's read facts are its printed summary; URLs and publishers are fixture placeholders. Model replies in offline tests are fixtures, not a live model accuracy evaluation.

facts.value: Board approved standalone unaudited results for Q2/H1 FY2027 (Sept 30, 2026). Net profit Rs.41,591.21 lakh for the quarter, total income Rs.244,246.10 lakh, Gross NPA Rs.104,302.01 lakh, Net NPA Rs.34,417.65 lakh, CAR 21.26%
Authorised share capital increased from Rs.10,000 lakh to Rs.20,000 lakh after RBI/shareholder approval
Transferred 974 NPA accounts to ARCs for Rs.13,122 lakh consideration
